# Opaque core inside an alpha-blended cover; group opacity with a solid override.
group display
  box base -10 -8 -2 20 16 2
  sphere core 0 0 5 4
  box cover -7 -6 0 14 12 12
  material display 0.2 0.6 0.9 0 0.25 0.25
  material core 1 0.25 0.05 0.2 0.35
  material base 0.3 0.35 0.4 0.6 0.4
end
